response.sql: WITH proj_rate AS (SELECT s.arcref AS arcref, p.fundflux AS fundflux, SUM(s.gbsize) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(s.spanmin), 0) AS rate FROM scans s JOIN projects p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref GROUP BY s.arcref, p.fundflux), bench AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS b FROM proj_rate WHERE rate IS NOT NULL) SELECT pr.arcref, pr.fundflux, pr.rate, pr.rate - bench.b AS gap FROM proj_rate pr, bench WHERE pr.rate > bench.b ORDER BY gap DESC LIMIT 10
